reported_2025_balance_sheet_selected_fie.normalization_limit: Financial-subsidiary assets/deposits and cash restrictions require a separate enterprise-value and liquidity bridge; no net-cash conclusion is admitted.

reported_finance_company_cash_flow_expla: 2025 annual report: OCF decline partly attributed to lower deposits from group members and increased non-on-demand interbank deposits at the controlled finance company.
2026 Q1 report: OCF increase mainly attributed to a lower net increase in those non-on-demand interbank deposits.

working_capital_research_flags.interpretation_limit: These are reconciliation flags, not evidence of distributor inventory, demand deterioration or a valuation conclusion.
